name_vi: Ghế đôi quay lưng chung khung
description_en: A double chair with two opposite-facing woven seats sharing one central tall back frame; the front shows one complete seat, the side reveals the mirrored seat platforms on either side, and the rear shows the second seat with its own arm openings and stretcher. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the canonical FRONT reference of this exact product. Create ONE photorealistic alternate catalog view of THAT SAME OBJECT, rotating viewpoint only. Subject: A double chair with two opposite-facing woven seats sharing one central tall back frame; the front shows one complete seat, the side reveals the mirrored seat platforms on either side, and the rear shows the second seat with its own arm openings and stretcher. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.. Style Sang trọng: refined precise proportions and minimal plain hardware. Relative size medium within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: close herringbone V-shaped twill. Finish: natural matte honey-tan fibers. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact RIGHT-SIDE ELEVATION: orbit camera 90 degrees to the object's right from its canonical front, level with product center. Show its right profile; front-facing panel must be edge-on. Do not merely flip or mirror the front image. Preserve exact silhouette dimensions, finish color, weave, number and locations of all compartments, handles, legs, ribs, drawers, hinges, padding and secondary materials. Reveal the described previously hidden surfaces without redesigning the object. Match background, soft lighting, scale and center placement. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions. STRUCTURE CLARIFICATION: The front reference shows the NEAR chair of a double BACK-TO-BACK joined chair unit; the second chair is hidden directly behind the common back in that front image. In exact right-side elevation reveal EXACTLY TWO opposite-facing chair seats, one extending left and one extending right from the ONE shared vertical back frame at the center, with corresponding plain armrests. Do not add a third seat, do not create side-facing radial wings, and do not reduce the unit to a single chair. Keep the front-reference chair's exact bamboo rail thickness, honey finish, herringbone panels, proportions and bindings.
